translation:
Title: Notice of Active-Duty Enlisted Recruitment Schedule for Each Military Branch (October 2026)

The Military Manpower Administration (병무청) operates an active-duty enlisted recruitment system. Under this system, persons liable for military service may apply for military specialties related to their major, qualifications, licences, experience and similar background, and then serve in that field. The recruitment schedule for active-duty enlisted personnel in each military branch is attached. It covers those who apply in October 2026 and enlist in January 2027.

Attachment (1 file): '26년 10월 각 군 현역병 모집계획(배부용).hwpx (October 2026 Active-Duty Enlisted Recruitment Plan for Each Branch, for distribution) (1 MB). The content of this attachment was not read for this translation.
